_help.measure_diameter: Master switch. true = measure diameter and use it to break appearance ties. false = pure recognition (no measurement at all).
_help.tie_confidence: Diameter is used ONLY when 2 or more models score at least this confidence (0..1). Same-pattern wheels both score high, so this catches them while leaving confident single matches alone. Raise it to be stricter.
_help.diameter_tolerance_pct: A model's stored diameter must be within this percent of the live measurement to be accepted.
_help.fit_method: How the enclosing circle is fitted to the binary mask.

fit_method_options.min-enclosing: Min enclosing circle over ALL mask pixels.
fit_method_options.hull: Convex hull of the main fragments first (drops small specks).

_help.threshold_method: How the binary mask cut is chosen.

threshold_method_options.otsu: Automatic per-frame (OpenCV Otsu). threshold_value is ignored.

_help.threshold_value: The fixed cut used when threshold_method is 'fixed'.
_help.show_binary_mask: true = pop the binary-mask debug window after each inspection.
_help.show_heatmap_overlay: true = render the anomaly heatmap over the captured frame (in memory only).
_help.note: Edit and re-run an inspection; no restart needed.
